branch_taken: The user's rule: if A8 works, combine active experiments with an adaptive noise budget or extend A8 toward 16 states; if A8 does not work, diagnose why. A8 failed its headline (GAE8 a: WRONG 5/36; c: ID 5/12), so this plan takes the diagnose branch: it tests the 033 diagnosis on fresh seeds and a stop rule built from it. The noise combination (adaptive budget, active only after a contradiction, so clean traces pay nothing; the fix for v0.29.0's GNR7 regression) and 16 states are deferred to v0.32.0 and are conditional on GA9 passing
process: LEAN (standing go t133s553 still needs a ledgered build_authorization_034 before any code): plan locked before data; seedcheck_034 before seeds are drawn; independent recount; CNF reference audit; pre-freeze gates test on a sealed smoke block; failures published; evidence labels; one run, no tuning, no reruns, no resume
question: Why did A8 name wrong machines, and does a stop rule that also rules out larger consistent machines (up to a declared state bound) make active identification sound while keeping its gain over passive traces?
motivation: Study 033 (Observed): A8 ID 5/12 at 12 states vs 0/12 for S5, S1 and A8_random (paired +0.417 [0.167, 0.667]); WRONG 5/36. Every WRONG stopped 'unique' at n_min below the truth's reachable size (11, 11, 11, 10 of 12; 6 of 8), and every 'unique' stop at the truth's size was ID. All 8 'indistinguishable' stops were same_future. Inferred: uniqueness at the least consistent size is an Occam certificate, not identification; and the residual AMB is start-state ambiguity

hypotheses.H1_mechanism: (diagnosis, replication) on fresh seeds, every A8 WRONG has n_min below the truth's reachable size
hypotheses.H2_sound_stop: with a declared state bound N, a stop rule that rules out every behaviourally different consistent machine of size n_min..N gives WRONG 0 and keeps the active gain
hypotheses.H3_start_state: most remaining AMB is ambiguity in the start state only (same future behaviour from the current state)

arms.A9: A8 (033) with a bounded stop rule. Declared bound N = the family's nominal size (8, 12 or 16; controls 3), given to every arm as a prior and stated in the report. Each round: (1) least consistent machine M1 (as A8); (2) search n = n_min..N for a consistent machine M2 that differs from M1 in behaviour from the current state: a bounded distinguishing-word encoding with word length <= N + n_M1 - 1 (complete for Moore machines); (3) if found, the shortest separating word by product BFS, execute it through the step-only wrapper, repeat; if none exists for every n <= N, stop ID_future; (4) then the same search from the start state; if none, ID. Up to K = 64 extra actions
arms.A9_random: control for chosen vs more data: the passive prefix plus exactly A9's extra-action count of seeded random actions, then the A9 stop check without further actions
arms.A8: frozen v0.30.0 arm, unchanged (brute/scalesearch8); replicates the 033 failure for H1
arms.S5: passive v0.27.0 arm with the 031 identify probe, unchanged
arms.S1: passive baseline with the identify probe, unchanged

design.world_access: step-only wrapper over experiments/worlds_026.py, as in 033; the truth is used only by the scorer
design.labels: ID (a single behaviour class from the start state up to N, equal to the truth); IDF (identified from the current state on, start state still ambiguous; scored as not ID); AMB; WRONG (a single class not equal to the truth); IDU (budget). A8, S5 and S1 keep their 033 labels
design.budget: 120 s per arm per case; 10 s per SAT query hard cap; K = 64; eps 0
design.soundness: every separating word re-simulated on M1 and M2; the truth rechecked on every extended trace; the A9 'no M2 up to N' verdicts rechecked by the reference on scale8

heldout_ranges.note: fresh 100x0001 ranges; pre-plan scan (Observed, 2026-10-30): no standalone token in these ranges in tracked text or in the sealed .gz archives. Drawn only after a ledgered seedcheck_034

criteria.G10: controls: ID 6/6 for A9 and S5

runtime_estimate: about 900-1500 s on 8 workers (36 cases, 5 arms, up to 120 s each; the bounded M2 search costs more than A8's); cap 1800 s, G_RT fails above it (Inferred)
what_counts_as_failure: any GA9 clause failing, GCH9, G_sound or G10 failing, any WRONG for A9; failures are published, not tuned
next_if_pass: v0.32.0: A9 with an adaptive noise budget (0 flips until the exact search contradicts, then B(t)), so clean traces pay no cost; and A9 toward 16 states
next_if_fail: publish the failing clause; if GDIAG8 fails, the 033 diagnosis is Rejected and the next plan studies the WRONG cases directly
limitations: the declared bound N is a prior the arms are given; identification without a bound is impossible in general
